description: This file defines a React component named ActiveUsersChart that provides a user interface for visualizing active user data over time. It includes a toolbar with filters for daily, weekly, and monthly granularity, and renders a child chart component. The component manages state for the selected time bucket, hints, loading, and errors, and interacts with external components and APIs to display the data.

methods.name: ActiveUsersChart
methods.description: React functional component that renders a chart with a filter toolbar for active users over time.
